title: Elf Bar 600 Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a simple and sustainable way to enjoy Elf Bar’s standout flavours. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Blueberry Sour Raspberry Flavour: A bold mix of juicy blueberries and tart raspberries, striking the perfect balance between sweet and sour. The deep, fruity richness of blueberries blends seamlessly with the sharp tang of raspberry, creating a bright and refreshingly layered vape. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a convenient, flavour-packed alternative, these prefilled pods ensure the same great performance that Elf Bar is known for.
